note: Amika (brand) is operated by Fixpoint, Inc. (per site footer: '© 2026 Amika – Fixpoint, Inc.'). Founders Jakub Cichon (CTO) and Dylan Mikus (CEO) are both 2x YC founders who pivoted an earlier YC-backed startup into Amika; the product (open-source core at github.com/gofixpoint/amika, hosted cloud platform) launched publicly via a 'Show HN' post around 2026-09-15. YC directory confirms Fall 2025 batch, Active status, founded 2023, 2 employees, New York City — domain matches the card's amika.dev. No press coverage, Crunchbase/PitchBook data, or company statement about funding amount, round type, or revenue was found within the search budget; Crunchbase page returned a Cloudflare block.
